definition: Resolution or firm determination in practice.
notes: Citation removed in the 2026-11-09 Wave 12 audit: the record cited AN 10.176 (Cunda), which contains no form of `adhiṭṭhāna`. DN 33 does list `cattāri adhiṭṭhānāni`, but those are the four foundations (discernment, truth, generosity, calming), a different sense from `resolution`, so it is not substituted. The record is uncited until a verified source for the resolution sense is found.
